beats.say: You'd need cranes for this. They had chisels.
lines: One hill, carved into a temple

beats.say: Two lakh tonnes patthar, haath se kaatkar hataaya gaya.
beats.cap: Two lakh tonnes of rock, cut away by hand.
lines: of rock, cut away by hand

beats.say: This is the Kailasa temple at Ellora, carved around 760 CE, under King Krishna the First.
They didn't build it up. They started at the roof, and carved down.
Ek galat chot, aur poora patthar barbaad. Koi undo nahin.
beats.cap: One wrong cut, and the whole rock is ruined. No undo.
lines: one wrong cut ruins the rock

beats.say: What's left is thirty-three metres tall. One single piece of rock.
beats.credit: Photo: Ms Sarah Welch, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons

beats.say: Aur kitna time laga? Koi pakka nahin jaanta. Estimates run from five years to a hundred and fifty.
beats.cap: And how long did it take? Nobody knows for sure. Estimates run from five years to a hundred and fifty.

beats.say: Send this to the friend who thinks you need cranes to build big. Every Thursday, one thing India built. Follow for number two.
lines: Send to your friend who needs cranes
